sentences.text:
Subrata Ghosh & Anr vs Unknown on 26 February, 2026
26.02.2026
Item No.27
Ct.No.34
 (Nmd)
 C.R.R. 76 of 2026

In the matter of : Subrata Ghosh & Anr.
 ....Petitioners  Mr. Ayan Bhattacharjee,Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Shounak Mondal  .....For the Petitioners  1.
The instant revisional application has been filed for quashing of the entire proceedings by the petitioners being the husband and the mother-in- law of the opposite party no.2 under Sections 498A, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Heard the submission of the learned Advocate for the petitioners.

It transpires that on March 2013 the matrimonial dispute cropped up and subsequently a suit was filed under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act which was decreed on contest in the year 2022 and after the same this complaint has been lodged against the petitioners under the aforesaid provisions.
3.
The proceeding under D.V. Act is also pending filed against the present petitioners.
The investigation has been culminated into filing charge-sheet, which is not in consonance with the mandate of the Hon'ble Supreme Court as no opinion formed during investigation.
The seized articles are also handed over by way of zimmanama to the opposite party no.2.
Therefore, prima facie, an arguable case has been made which requires hearing.

4. Learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners is accordingly directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the opposite parties through speed post and file the affidavit-of- service on the next date of hearing.

5. Matter to appear as "Contested Application" four weeks hence before the regular Bench.
6.
Let there be an order of interim stay of further proceeding against the present petitioners till 30th April, 2026 or until further order, whichever is earlier.
7. Parties are to act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
